page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c4m1.large is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the shared instance family running under the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server allocates 2 burstable vCPUs across 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Supported CPU instruction flags include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES-NI cryptographic acceleration.

The instance provides 0.5 GB of system memory, which establishes an asymmetric compute-to-memory ratio of 0.25 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled with the server, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for operating system installation and filesystem persistence. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero physical GPUs provisioned. The baseline network throughput is rated at 0 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance profile.

With its burstable CPU allocation and minimal memory footprint, the server delivers an entry-tier baseline profile for intermittent workloads. The 0.5 GB memory capacity imposes strict runtime limits, excluding container orchestration runtimes, production database servers, and standard memory-intensive applications. It is functionally suited for lightweight background monitoring, simple scheduled cron utilities, low-frequency automation scripts, and small network proxy forwarding services.
